script_text: Stop! Taurus, the cosmos demands your absolute and immediate attention this morning. The Sun and Venus are parked in your 7th House of Partnerships, forming a tense opposition to your 1st House Sun. But listen closely, Earth sign: Jupiter is trining your ruling Venus from the 11th House, bringing massive expansion to your social circle. In love, that Venus energy makes you truly irresistible. Singles attract a powerfully magnetic soulmate today, while couples must deeply negotiate a shared budget before resentment builds. On career and money, the North Node lights up your 2nd House of Self-Worth alongside Jupiter's trine, opening a door through group income or professional network—do not dismiss this funding source. Warning: absolutely avoid signing any contracts late at night. Your biggest unexpected gift is very immediate financial recognition. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you catch the shift before it lands.
